verifications.claim: Chipotle is hosting a Buy-One-Get-One (BOGO) deal for the 2026 Stanley Cup Playoffs on April 20, 2026, after 3 p.m. local time.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "after 3 p.m. local time on Monday, April 20" (R1); "On the first Monday of the 2026 Stanley Cup Playoffs (April 20), after 3 p.m." (R2); "On Monday, April 20, after 3 p.m. local time" (R3, R5)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references directly state the BOGO deal for the 2026 playoffs on April 20, 2026, after 3 p.m. local time.

verifications.claim: Customers wearing a hockey jersey or apparel at participating U.S. and Canada locations can purchase one entree and get one free in-restaurant.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "wears a hockey jersey at participating restaurants in the U.S. and Canada" (R1); "wearing a hockey jersey to a participating Chipotle in the United States or Canada" (R2); "wear a hockey jersey to participating restaurants in the U.S. and Canada" (R3, R5); "wear a hockey jersey" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: References clearly support wearing a hockey jersey at U.S./Canada locations for BOGO entree in-restaurant, but do not mention 'apparel'; claim broadens beyond precise reference language.

verifications.claim: The BOGO deal is buy one entree, get one free.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "buy one, get one deal on entrées" (R1); "buy one, get one entree deal" (R2); "BUY-ONE-GET-ONE (BOGO) entrée" (R3, R5); "free entrée with the purchase of another entrée" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: All references directly describe the deal as buy one entree, get one free.

verifications.claim: The BOGO deal has a maximum of five free items per check.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "limited to five free menu items per check" (R3, R5); "up to five (5) BOGO redemptions per person" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: R3/R5 directly state limit of five free items per check; R4 supports equivalent limit of five free entrees.

verifications.claim: The BOGO deal is on Monday, April 20, 2026, after 3 p.m. local time.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Monday, April 20... after 3 p.m. local time" (R1); "first Monday of the 2026 Stanley Cup Playoffs (April 20)" (R2); "Monday, April 20, after 3 p.m. local time... Valid only on April 20, 2026" (R3, R5)
verifications.reasoning: References explicitly confirm the date as Monday, April 20, 2026, after 3 p.m.

verifications.claim: The BOGO deal requires wearing a hockey jersey to a participating store.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "customer who wears a hockey jersey" (R1); "fans wearing a hockey jersey" (R2); "fans who wear a hockey jersey" (R3, R5); "guests who wear a hockey jersey" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: All references directly state the requirement of wearing a hockey jersey at participating locations.

verifications.claim: The BOGO deal is only valid in-restaurant, not for online, mobile, or delivery orders.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Redeemable in-restaurant only... not valid for catering, mobile, online or delivery orders" (R3, R5); "available in-restaurant only... valid for in-store orders only" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: References explicitly limit to in-restaurant and exclude online, mobile, delivery.

verifications.claim: Chipotle released a limited-edition, custom-branded hockey jersey for the first time.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "first-ever limited-edition hockey jersey" (R1); "first-ever limited-edition hockey jersey... For the first time, Chipotle is releasing a limited-edition hockey jersey" (R3, R5)
verifications.reasoning: References directly state it is Chipotle's first-ever limited-edition/custom hockey jersey.

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "only 75 jerseys will be available" (R1, R2); "only 75 available... Only 75 jerseys will be available" (R3, R5)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references directly confirm exactly 75 jerseys launched.

verifications.claim: Fans could enter for a chance to win a custom-branded jersey by exchanging 10 Rewards points via the Chipotle Rewards Exchange.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "exchange 10 rewards points for an entry to win one jersey... through the Chipotle Rewards Exchange" (R1); "available exclusively through the Chipotle Rewards Exchange" (R3, R5)
verifications.reasoning: R1 directly states exchanging 10 points for entry via Rewards Exchange; R3/R5 confirm via Rewards Exchange.

verifications.claim: The entry period for the jersey ran from April 18 to May 2, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "started Saturday, April 18 and will run through Saturday, May 2" (R1); "Promotion Period: 4/18/26 at 12:01 a.m. PT – 5/2/26 at 11:59 p.m. PT" (R3, R5)
verifications.reasoning: References directly match the entry period dates.
